assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The arrhythmia remains poorly characterized, necessitating extended monitoring to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is ordered to capture these elusive events over an extended period.
